descriptions.before: Pausing Behavior – When a locally-simulated mechanism is not in a streamed-in region, its simulation is paused, but simulation of other locally-owned mechanisms continues. The only exception is that simulation of the replication focus is never paused, even if it's outside of a streamed-in region.
descriptions.after: Pausing Behavior - When a locally-simulated mechanism is not in a streamed-in region, its simulation is paused, but simulation of other locally-owned mechanisms continues. The only exception is that simulation of the replication focus is never paused, even if it's outside of a streamed-in region.

descriptions.before:
Pausing Criteria – The client triggers a pause when it does not have content streamed in up to at least Workspace.StreamingMinRadius.

Unpausing Criteria – The client unpauses when it has content loaded up to Workspace.StreamingMinRadius. If the player's character is moving at a high rate of speed when the pause begins, the client might wait longer to resume in order to avoid rapid pausing and unpausing.

Pausing Behavior – When a pause is triggered, all local simulation on the client is paused and the Player.GameplayPaused property is set.
descriptions.after: Pausing Criteria - The client triggers a pause when it does not have content streamed in up to at least Workspace.StreamingMinRadius. Unpausing Criteria - The client unpauses when it has content loaded up to Workspace.StreamingMinRadius. If the player's character is moving at a high rate of speed when the pause begins, the client might wait longer to resume in order to avoid rapid pausing and unpausing. Pausing Behavior - When a pause is triggered, all local simulation on the client is paused and the Player.GameplayPaused property is set.

descriptions.before:
Pausing Criteria – The client triggers a pause when the replication focus is not in a streamed-in region.

Unpausing Criteria – The client unpauses when the replication focus is inside a streamed-in region. Similar to MinimumRadiusPause, the client might wait longer to resume if the player's character is moving at a high rate of speed.

Pausing Behavior – Similar to Disabled but no exception for the replication focus. If simulation of the replication focus is paused, the Player.GameplayPaused property is set.
descriptions.after: Pausing Criteria - The client triggers a pause when the replication focus is not in a streamed-in region. Unpausing Criteria - The client unpauses when the replication focus is inside a streamed-in region. Similar to MinimumRadiusPause, the client might wait longer to resume if the player's character is moving at a high rate of speed. Pausing Behavior - Similar to Disabled but no exception for the replication focus. If simulation of the replication focus is paused, the Player.GameplayPaused property is set.
